items.name: Valve Chamber (builder)
items.desc: Choose the chamber type, add valves in flow order. Clearances, isolating valves and dismantling joints are checked live.

items.name: Doors
items.desc: 17 designs in four materials with 11 glass types, handles, side glass and fanlight. Open and close in 3D.

items.name: Windows
items.desc: Casement, sliding, awning, double hung, louvre and fixed windows with nets, blinds, shutters and safety glass rules.

items.name: Staircase
items.desc: Riser, tread, landing, slab depth and floor opening come from the floor height and the stair rules.

items.name: Railing / handrail
items.desc: Straight, L-corner or sloped rails. Post section, span and baluster gap come from the use and the load. Optional self-closing gate.

items.name: Pumps
items.desc: Five pump types. Enter flow and head: motor size, stages and pipe size follow, and designs that fail velocity or power rules are blocked.

items.name: Boundary Wall
items.desc: Five boundary wall and fence types. Column size, footing depth and quantities follow the height, and designs that fail the rules are blocked.

items.name: RCC Column
items.desc: Rectangular or round RCC column with real rebar: main bars, ties, cross-ties, spiral. Rules checked live; GLB, OBJ, DXF drawing and bar schedule.

items.name: Room Interior (Bedroom)
items.desc: Full bedroom interior: wardrobe with loft (sliding or hinged), bed, bedside cabinets, study desk, bookshelf, dresser, curtain and cove light. Circulation and window rules are checked.

items.name: Reinforcement Bar + Cage Capacity
items.desc: Plain, Gr 420, TMT 500 and epoxy-coated bars. Eight bar shapes with ld, lap and hook lengths, plus RC beam and column cages with moment, shear and axial capacity.

items.name: HDD Highway and Railway Crossing
items.desc: HDPE pipe drilled under a highway and a railway in one bore. Plan, long section and cross sections, cover checks, and GLB, OBJ, STL, DXF and SVG downloads.

items.name: Railway Crossing Methods
items.desc: One pipe under a railway by six methods. Casing, pits and cover checks, 3D, plan, long section, cross section, detail, and GLB, OBJ, STL, DXF and SVG downloads.

items.name: Road Crossing Methods
items.desc: One pipe under a highway by six methods. Casing, pits and cover checks, 3D, plan, long section, cross section, detail, and GLB, OBJ, STL, DXF and SVG downloads.
